criteria.description: Gate completes within 30 seconds
Documentation build wall-clock increase <=10%
criteria.evidence: seo_verify 0.07s over 700-page _site vs 83-189s CI docs-pages builds -> +0.08%
criteria.notes: MEASURED. Marginal cost of the added verifier step: 0.07s (best of 3) over a synthetic 700-page / 2.7 MB _site, against real docs-pages CI build durations of 83-189s (6 most recent successes) -> +0.08% worst case, far inside the 10% ceiling. Scope: NFR-008 constrains the *increase*, and the increase is what was timed. The only other build change is seo_postprocess emitting one extra meta tag inside a pass that already existed. A full end-to-end before/after DocFX build was not run because .NET/DocFX is unavailable in this environment.
